summary.answer: Creates armor-shard quick-inventory list, compact gray-box list and PC stash-count grid. States distinguish inventory-open, hidden quick-equip preference and keyboard/mouse, with model/input watchers validating state. It sets default focus and IDs, installs close and optional PostLoadFunc, then configures free-cursor handling and quick-inventory navigation before returning self. Armor gameplay and inventory contents remain provider contracts.

summary.answer: Initializes last-stand progress/beingRevived only if unset, then constructs health, armor, portrait, healing ability and contextual inventory views. Health/armor/portrait receive the predicted-client model when nonnil; heal receives playerGadget1. LowHealth requires health above zero and at most75. Armor repair lists accept REPAIR plus quickEquip1; health lists accept type health, unequipped0, quickEquip1. Links update the health inventory slots; constructor completion does not establish inventory actions or health mutation in gameplay.
